messages.content: 报销期限和需要的材料分别是什么？

necessary_evidence.text: 费用报销应在费用发生后30日内提交申请。
费用报销申请须附合规票据。

expected.behavior: 合并期限30日与须附合规票据，分别引用。
expected.action_constraints: 允许不同工具路径；按证据与最终行为评判，不要求固定查询或固定调用顺序。
expected.must_not: 把互补资料判冲突；推导合规票据的未提供细则。

criteria.scope: original real CLI, no manual rewrite, no evidence supplied to model beyond original tools
criteria.strict_business_pass: Correct source-bounded main conclusion, supported citations, required gaps explicit, no unsupported policy assertion or execution advice; budget/framework failure tracked separately
labels: 必要证据未召回，模型未恢复
首次未召回，但模型通过后续动作恢复
必要证据已可见，模型仍判断错误
主答案正确，但引用错误或附带无依据断言
工程异常、预算不足或路径未触发
criteria.R07: Check visible scope and publicly stated scope-based explanation; no order/ID counterfactual, so cannot causally prove independence from ranking
criteria.E03: Do not choose natural/work days or recommend one as an execution rule without evidence
criteria.C13: Assess visible30day+15day claims, count copies once; never treat hidden corpus sections or copied_from metadata absent from actual search as model-visible
criteria.M01: Same original CLI interactive session, exact two design messages; check per-turn evidence and final context use
criteria.F01: Use original search failure switch; if agent truly recovers using another working tool, report actual recovery rather than inventing failure
criteria.observer: Passive wrappers of _tool_response and Agent.reply record ORIGINAL returned objects and metadata, then return them unchanged; no tool replacement/retrieval override
criteria.repeat_policy: 1 per case plus2 for C01/C11/C13; no success selection; max concurrency2 independent processes; CLI errors preserved; external900s watchdog separate from tool budget
criteria.B1_working_definition: query/initial retrieval evidence acquisition improvements; not implemented in this run
criteria.B2_working_definition: related/conflicting evidence supplementation, source diversity and evidence-aware decision/answer control; not implemented in this run
